reference_description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages for different methods across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis contains the categorical labels "Mathverse", "MMLU", and "Physics", with each category having grouped bars. The vertical axis represents accuracy, labeled "Accuracy (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 50% to 62% and tick labels at intervals of 2%. Each category features six bars that are color-coded and patterned according to a legend: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (blue with diagonal stripes), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (orange with diagonal stripes), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (green with diagonal stripes). In Mathverse, the DAPO+Self-reflection bar reaches approximately 53%, while while the PPO bar is slightly above 53% and the DAPO + Self-reflection is slightly above 56% and remaining with 53-56%. For MMLU, bars range from slightly above 54% (PPO) to about 57% (SRPO), and in Physics, the DAPO+Self-reflection bar reaches close to 61%, with the PPO bar at approximately 57% and remaining are within these ranges. They do not follow any specific sorting order, and three bars have diagonal stripes in them. A legend is provided at top with the category and their bar.
